cases.rationale: The crop shows two slices of bread supporting melted square cheese toppings with red sauce, identifiable as open-faced cheese sandwiches. Behind the plate is an open blue bowl of cereal with a spoon extending to the left. The arranged meal sits on an eating tabletop. The tall V8 container is a straight-sided can, without a bottle neck; the flat plate is not a bowl, and the cheese toast is not pizza, cake, or a hot dog. I considered each of the 75 definitions against the whole crop; no unresolved category ambiguity remains.

The bathroom contains a toilet with raised seat/lid, a pedestal sink and faucet, and a single wooden chair at the left. Several toiletries have identifiable bottle bodies and narrowed dispensing necks. Small thin items crowded at the right side of the faucet could include a toothbrush, but a bristled head cannot be resolved, so toothbrush is unclear. The sink is not a portable bowl, the mirror is not a television, and the framed wall decoration is not a book. I considered all 75 definitions individually; the toothbrush is the unresolved category distinction.

Multiple actual black-and-white cattle stand closely together in grass; the foreground animal's broad muzzle, ears and body establish cattle identity. Their patches are not zebra stripes, and the animals are not horses or sheep. Ear tags do not establish any accessory category. Distant grass, trees and buildings supply no identifiable additional defined object. I checked every one of the 75 definitions; no unresolved category ambiguity remains.

Two bundled people carry blue snow sleds beside a snowbank and brick building. The long foreground sled has raised side rails and a towing loop, while the other has a broad saucer-shaped body with a grip; neither shows a snowboard deck and binding assembly. They are also not skateboards or surfboards. The white porch and snow do not identify furniture or a bed. I explicitly considered all 75 definitions; no unresolved category ambiguity remains.

A person holds a large round pizza with visible crust and cheese/topping surface in front of an open, burning brick cooking oven. The oven cavity establishes an actual conventional oven rather than a microwave or generic fireplace surface alone. The large circular metal support is a baking tray, not a bowl or flying disc. No eating-table identity or distinct knife is visible. I assessed every one of the 75 definitions; no unresolved category ambiguity remains.

A handled black mug containing a drink sits above a breakfast plate on a cloth-covered eating table; a table knife lies along the right edge. The plate contains bacon, eggs and small pancakes. Bacon is not an identifiable frankfurter, the pancakes are excluded from cake, and there is no bread-supported sandwich filling. The plate is flat rather than a bowl, and the mug lacks a wine-glass stem. I considered all 75 definitions individually; no unresolved category ambiguity remains.

A child in a yellow shirt holds a pink-and-white electric toothbrush at her open mouth; the brush head and brushing context identify the object. The handle is not a remote control or cell phone. The shirt's graphic is printed imagery rather than an actual second person or object, and the fabric background does not establish bed or couch identity. I explicitly considered all 75 definitions; no unresolved category ambiguity remains.

Several actual people stand or move on separate narrow skis with ski poles in a snowy scene. These are skis rather than snowboard decks, and the upright course markers are not traffic signals or stop signs. Background trunks and structural posts do not identify a bench or chair. I evaluated each of the 75 definitions against the whole monochrome crop; no unresolved category ambiguity remains.

The close crop contains several actual doughnuts, including a large sugar-coated ring in front, a chocolate-glazed ring at upper left and other coated pastries at the edges. Their fried dough and icing/sugar identify donuts rather than plain bagels, cake slices or sandwiches. A light backing surface alone does not establish a dining table or a bowl. I considered every one of the 75 definitions; no unresolved category ambiguity remains.

A small child in pink stands on separate skis with an adult directly behind, and another skier is farther right. Their narrow separate ski tips and poles do not identify snowboards. The bright lamp on a tall pole is a street/slope light rather than a traffic-signal assembly; the snowy trees are unpotted. I checked all 75 definitions individually across the entire crop; no unresolved category ambiguity remains.

An actual person carries a yellow shoulder tote and holds a red drinking cup beside a toilet with raised seat/lid. The tote is a soft shoulder bag rather than a backpack or suitcase; the cup has a broad drinking rim rather than a bottle neck or wine-glass stem. The black oval wall unit is a toilet-paper dispenser, not a television, clock or remote. The fixture is a toilet rather than a sink or portable bowl. I considered each of the 75 definitions; no unresolved category ambiguity remains.

A helmeted person is airborne above snowy trees with both feet bound to one broad snowboard. The binding and snow-sport context distinguish the board from a skateboard or surfboard; printed board markings are not actual separate objects. Clothing and the helmet do not establish a backpack, and the distant trees have no pots. I explicitly assessed all 75 definitions; no unresolved category ambiguity remains.
